editorial:
Imagine heading to sunny Palm Springs with your best friends to ring in the New Year with drinks, music, and plenty of flirting. You start the trip feeling great, but the vibe quickly shifts from a party to a nightmare. The group is all looking for that perfect midnight kiss, but they end up letting a complete stranger into their circle who has a very dark secret. It starts off as a fun getaway, but you will soon feel the tension rise as you realize someone in the house is not who they claim to be.

You will likely enjoy the fast pace and the way the suspense builds up to the big reveal. While some of the acting is a bit over the top, it fits the style of a TV movie and keeps things entertaining. The twists are surprising and will keep you guessing until the end.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shock when it turns out the killer was hiding in plain sight. After a series of scary chases through the house, the final survivor fights back during the midnight countdown. You see the killer finally get caught and defeated just as the clock hits twelve. The survivor manages to escape the house, leaving the nightmare behind, though the trauma of the night stays with them as the sun rises on New Year's Day.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves campy horror movies and surprise twists.
